asset_action.description: Allows the model to run an asset action block.
rules: MANDATORY: ASSET_ACTION requires a loaded skill context with action schemas.

With file_manager loaded, ATTACH_FILE_BY_ID and ATTACH_FILE_BY_PATH attach whole existing text/images through the same attachment pipeline as ATTACH_FILE_CONTENT. Operation names are case-insensitive. Use id or ids for persistent IDs, path or paths for linked-folder paths; never reinterpret a missing ID as a path. Paths preserve case and stay within currently linked folders. Each BY_PATH call replaces the previous temporary path set; pins are preserved. At most five files; existing byte/text limits apply. Wait for FOLLOW-UP to inspect actual text/pixels. These operations never create files; omit missing TXT files and create captions later with create_asset_file. Prefer the single ATTACH_FILE_CONTENT marker for ordinary attachment and text-window reads.
